dictionary.tangent_cone_source: ell2(u,u), equivalently the projected class of q2(iota*u,iota*u)
dictionary.ell3_role: third Taylor order / quartic action / deformation representative; not the quadratic second-order tangent-cone source
dictionary.cokernel_test: the class of (1/2)q2(u,u) in the Noether-compatible cokernel of q1 restricted to correction class C
dictionary.cohomology_test: [ell2(u,u)] on ell1 cohomology when that residual crosswalk is certified

tangent_cone_naturality.field_change: Phi=F(Psi), T=DF at the background, with invertible equation-bundle map U
tangent_cone_naturality.zero_locus_transformation: Z_2^{C'}=T^{-1}(Z_2^C) when T maps the declared harmonic input and correction class C isomorphically onto C'
tangent_cone_naturality.invariant_statement: vanishing/nonvanishing of the complete obstruction map and the isomorphism class of its zero locus
tangent_cone_naturality.representative_dependent_statement: individual source coefficients, chosen cokernel basis, and the displayed equations before quotient
tangent_cone_naturality.category_guard: bounded/quasiperiodic, smooth secular, and causal/retarded correction classes have different images; changing C is not an admissible coordinate redefinition
tangent_cone_naturality.cyclic_L_infinity_form: ell2 changes by an ell1-coboundary under an admissible cyclic F2, so its induced cohomology obstruction is natural
tangent_cone_naturality.mixed_ell3_strengthening: the separate 22-row witness proves nonremovability of the landed mixed ell3 within its declared filtered cyclic F2/F3 class

claim_boundary: This certificate fixes the Taylor normalization, the original-to-transferred source dictionary, and the natural transformation law of the complete finite-harmonic second-order obstruction map. The zero locus is invariant up to the induced isomorphism only when the field redefinition preserves the declared harmonic carrier, Noether/gauge reduction, boundaries, and correction category. It does not identify Berger retained rows with Einstein-like, extra-Weyl, topological, or particle modes and does not complete a background-specific mode-pair source table.
